## Summary

Shipped F003: a `validate_plans_strict()` probe in `scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py` that walks every locked plan under `docs/plans/`, runs `jsonschema` validation against `plan.schema.json`, and emits per-plan + summary `CheckResult` entries surfaced in both text and `--json` output. The new `--validate-plans-strict` CLI flag promotes failures to FAIL (exit 2 via the strict-codes matrix); default mode keeps them as advisory WARN with exit 0. Added 5 fixture tests at `test_doctor_validate_plans_strict_f003.py` covering live-plan-clean, malformed-frontmatter strict-fail, exit-code 2 path, advisory exit-0 path, and JSON detail-array shape. Surfaced one pre-existing schema-vs-runtime tightness during probe development: `plan.schema.json` capped `title` at 120 chars but one locked plan carried a 137-char title — fixed additi
